parole.significato: the sludge left behind by a river that has retreated, alluvium
parole.testo: From Ancient Greek πηλός (pēlós, “clay”), or ἰλύς (ilús, “mud, slime”) with the Coptic ⲡⲓ- (pi-) masculine singular definite article, though ἰλύς (ilús, “mud, slime”) is feminine and would require ϯ- (ti-); originally this word was applied particularly to the alluvial deposit of the Nile.
